reply:
I've ported the LRU program to Zig. `node check.mjs` passes 5 of 5 example cases, and all 9 unit tests pass (`zig build test`).

**Checks against the original:** I ran the Clojure version on three generated 1,000,000-command inputs with capacities of 1,000,000, 100,000 and 1,000. The Zig output was byte-for-byte identical each time, and each run took 0.05–0.10 s. I also compared about a dozen edge cases: Windows line endings, blank lines, extra spaces, unknown commands, a value containing spaces
